anchor: ## Timing, cancellation and lifetime answer different questions
insert: The [selected request-value continuation](myhomeserver1-3.87.13-action-request-values.md) identifies the actual local descriptor constants `2.0` and `light.setStatus`, and traces captured target ID plus conditionally positive signed speed through the concrete merge into `params.id`/`params.speed`. Its outer request ID has a separate UUID-request producer. These local construction facts narrow the earlier descriptor/conversion premises, while full JSON, other parameters, runtime/provider success, downstream delivery and physical meaning remain unresolved.
